name: Roman theatre of Dougga
scope: The surviving and restored Roman theatre at Dougga, Tunisia, with the split limestone cavea, orchestra, raised stage and restored column groups.
era: The late second-century theatre with early twentieth-century restored seats and standing stage columns, as photographed in December 2025.

originalReview.notes: Exact author-native December 2025 stage and cavea photograph. The first uploader release and creator’s renamed Commons account are explicitly linked by the original user redirect and authoritative 2026 rename log.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
